Whack-a-Mole Game

Whack-a-Mole — moles pop up at random for 30 seconds. Whack as many as you can and chase the high score.

Press Start. 🐹 = 1 pt, ⭐ golden = 3 pts.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start — the 30-second timer begins.
  2. Tap moles as they pop up (golden ones are worth 3).
  3. Watch the timer — moles speed up near the end.
  4. Beat your saved high score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does scoring work?

You have 30 seconds. Each mole you whack scores 1 point (golden moles score 3 but vanish fast).

Does it get harder?

Moles appear faster and in greater numbers as the clock runs down.

Is my high score saved?

Your best score is saved in this browser.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully playable with touch.
